idea-plugin.name: Syntax Error Sound
idea-plugin.description:
Plays your custom error sound whenever a syntax or compilation error is detected in Android Studio!

Features:
  • Instant audio feedback on syntax errors
  • Smart cooldown to prevent overlapping sounds
  • Works across Kotlin, Java, XML, and all supported file types
  • Test sound action available under Tools -> Play Syntax Error Sound Test

action.description: Tests playing the custom syntax error sound
